results.description:
is the localization engineering platform. Teams measure translation quality, translate with LLMs, and proofread with native speakers. We are a small YC-backed team, fully remote, with paying customers.
This is our first marketing hire. You own content end to end: creation, publishing, distribution, measurement, and automation.
Apply through our careers page, not through this listing:
What you own
Blog posts, research articles, essays, changelogs, the newsletter. Distribution on LinkedIn, dev.to, Hacker News and Reddit. Interviewing our engineers and customers, then writing for both technical and non-technical readers. Weekly publishing, with volume growing through Claude workflows and templated distribution. SEO, GEO and AI search visibility, measured in Ahrefs, Search Console and the ad accounts. The outcomes: signups, citations, rankings, backlinks.
What we look for
Distribution results you can point at. A site you grew, a page that outranked an incumbent, a property that gets cited by AI assistants at volume. You write plainly, with no superlatives and no sentences that carry nothing. You code enough to automate your own workflow and distribution. You interview well and get people on the record saying something quotable. You use Claude daily as a production method and have opinions about prompting and output quality. You understand what Hacker News, the LinkedIn algorithm and AI systems reward. You work from Ahrefs and Search Console data.
Do not apply if
You do not use Claude daily. You plan work from keyword spreadsheets. Your job ends at publishing. You need a weekly brief. You call yourself non-technical. Your portfolio is generic. You want to manage a team right away.
What you get
Original engineering research to write about. The whole pipeline, from draft to measured impact. Claude Code and Claude Cowork budget for volume production. Small team, direct founder access. Conference and learning budget, flexible hours, health insurance.
Hiring process
Screening call with Max, our CEO. Trial project plus an interview. Offer. Four-week probation period. You hear back within a few days at every step.
How to apply
Apply on our careers page: The form there asks a few opinion questions instead of a CV. That form is the only application we review.

results.title: Junior Full-Stack Web Developer
results.description:
Junior Full-Stack Developer

Full-Time | $7-$10 USD/Hour Starting
Remote | Philippines or Indonesia

About the Role

We are looking for a smart, resourceful junior full-stack developer who wants the opportunity to grow into a major engineering role.

This position is designed for someone early in their career who already understands the fundamentals of web development but has the potential to become much more. You do not need to know everything yet. We care more about your problem-solving ability, technical curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

You will work across our SaaS platform—building features, fixing bugs, improving user workflows, and testing your own work. Initially, you will receive smaller, clearly defined assignments. As your skills and understanding of the product grow, you will be given greater responsibility and more complex projects.

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company—not someone looking for a short-term freelance project.

Responsibilities

Full-Stack Development

Build and improve frontend and backend features.

Fix bugs throughout the application.

Create and update user interfaces, forms, validation rules, and workflows.

Work with APIs, databases, and third-party integrations.

Read and understand an existing codebase.

Write clean, maintainable, and well-organized code.

Use Git to manage code changes and collaborate with the engineering team.

Participate in code reviews and apply feedback from senior developers.

Assist with deployments and post-deployment verification.

Testing and Product Quality

Test your own work thoroughly before submitting it for review.

Reproduce and investigate customer-reported issues.

Identify edge cases and unexpected user behavior.

Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, screenshots, or videos.

Perform regression testing to ensure changes do not break existing features.

Recommend improvements to usability, performance, and reliability.

Requirements

You must be able to independently read, understand, and evaluate code.
Do not apply if you rely on Claude to generate code that you cannot explain, debug, or verify yourself.**

Basic full-stack web development experience.

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git.

Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React.

Basic understanding of backend development, APIs, and databases.

Ability to troubleshoot problems using browser developer tools and logs.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to explain your thinking clearly and ask good questions.

Strong attention to detail and willingness to test your own work.

Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks.

Willingness to work overnight locally during U.S. business hours.

Reliable computer and internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

Experience building personal, school, freelance, or professional web applications.

Experience working with REST APIs and relational databases.

Familiarity with SaaS applications and subscription-based products.

Experience with Asana or similar project-management tools.

A GitHub profile, portfolio, or working application that demonstrates your abilities.

Previous experience working with a remote international team.

Professional experience is helpful, but it is not required if you can demonstrate strong technical ability through projects or practical work.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate:

Learns quickly and actively searches for solutions.

Can take a problem from investigation through implementation and testing.

Is comfortable admitting when they do not know something.

Accepts feedback without becoming defensive.

Pays attention to how the entire product works—not only the assigned ticket.

Looks for underlying causes instead of applying temporary fixes.

Shows the potential to take ownership of larger systems over time.

Wants to become a highly capable full-stack engineer.

What Success Looks Like

Assigned features and fixes are completed accurately and on time.

Code is tested before being submitted for review.

Questions are thoughtful, specific, and asked early.

Mistakes are learned from and are not repeatedly made.

Knowledge of the platform grows steadily.

The developer progresses from smaller assignments to independently owning features.

Responsibility and compensation can increase as technical ability and contribution grow.

Salary: $6 – $10 / hour Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role, you will collaborate with a regional sales and marketing team, and your primary objective will be to find customer projects that fit our product lines and spread the good name of Canonical across multiple different industries and geographies.

The role entails

Execute outbound sales & marketing campaigns

Research information about prospective customers and market trends

Generate high-quality leads for Senior Sellers to fuel a multi-million dollar pipeline

Own and close SMB opportunities within your designated territory

Collaborate across multiple teams and senior stakeholders to drive results

Help define the processes and policies for the team

Travel to events and conferences worldwide, presenting on booths and driving face-to-face marketing and sales opportunities

What we are looking for in you

Demonstrated success in SDR or outbound sales, with a track record of exceeding annual quotas and consistently driving qualified pipeline growth

Experience navigating prospective accounts from and into a senior executive level to identify new customer opportunities

Experience in enterprise software or technology sales

Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

Passion for business and technology

Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific

Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration

Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Verbal and written communication and negotiation skills

Result driven with an over-achiever spirit

Persistence & perseverance

Growth mindset - people from our team develop into all departments within the sales organization (Channel, IoT, Enterprise Sales, etc)

Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Annual compensation review

Recognition rewards

Annual holiday leave

Maternity and paternity leave

Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
